Technology stocks were firming in recent Tuesday trading after new tariffs on China announced Monday night exempted several Apple ( AAPL ) products, including the Apple Watch and AirPods, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 1.1% this afternoon while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 1.0%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Oracle ( ORCL ) was narrowly higher Tuesday, overcoming an earlier slump after the enterprise software firm reported $9.19 billion in Q1 revenue, rising 1% over year-ago levels but still lagging the Capital IQ consensus. Non-GAAP earnings topped Wall Street views. Oracle also approved a $12 billion increase for its stock buyback program and RBC Capital Markets raised its price target for the stock by $1 to $53 a share and reiterated its sector perform rating.
In other sector news:
(+) Cognizant Technology ( CTSH ) was hanging on to a small gain Tuesday afternoon after the technology services company said it was buying the Advanced Technology Group, a privately-held provider of customer and revenue management consulting and implementation services. Financial terms were not disclosed.
(+) InterXion Holding NV ( INXN ) was almost 2.5% higher on Tuesday after the data center company said it plans a 200 million euro ($233.6 million) private placement of its 4.75% senior notes due 2025. Net proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes, including certain expansion projects.
